visual_goal: Show the property page as cacheable fragments owned by source teams around one quote: the offer service feeds a single price composition, a separate display policy turns the breakdown into a headline, and checkout re-validates the quote by ID.
prompt: A left-to-right architecture illustration. At the far left, a guest request card with a calendar and two-adult-two-child icon, labeled 'Guest request', with one arrow into a central box 'Page composer'. Above 'Page composer', three small cacheable tiles side by side, each with a small cache-stack icon: 'Content' with a photo icon, 'Reviews' with a star icon, 'Trust' with a shield icon; one arrow from 'Page composer' up to each tile. To the right of 'Page composer', a lower row: one arrow into a box 'Offer service', then one arrow into a calculator-and-receipt box 'Price composition', then one arrow into a box with a rulebook icon 'Display policy', from which one curved arrow returns left into 'Page composer'. From 'Price composition' one arrow right, labeled 'quote ID', into a shopping-basket box 'Checkout'.
alt: A guest request reaches a page composer that pulls cacheable content, reviews and trust tiles and calls an offer service, a single price composition and a display policy that returns the headline; checkout receives the quote ID from price composition.

visual_goal: Show one quote from search to checkout as a swimlane: search shows cached batch totals, the property page gets an exact quote with an ID, and checkout re-validates that quote instead of recomputing.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane sequence diagram with five vertical lanes, each headed by a simple generic icon and a label: 'Guest', 'Search', 'Property page', 'Price composition', 'Checkout'. Horizontal arrows, top to bottom in this order: from 'Guest' to 'Search', labeled 'Lisbon, 2 to 9 August'; from 'Search' to 'Price composition', labeled 'batch quotes'; a dashed return arrow from 'Price composition' to 'Search', labeled 'cached totals'; from 'Property page' to 'Price composition', labeled 'exact quote'; a dashed return arrow from 'Price composition' to 'Property page', labeled 'quote Q1'; a dashed arrow from 'Property page' to 'Guest', labeled '€1,271.20 total'; from 'Checkout' to 'Price composition', labeled 're-validate Q1'; and a dashed return arrow from 'Price composition' to 'Checkout', labeled 'same total'.
alt: A swimlane of one quote: search gets cached batch totals, the property page gets exact quote Q1 and shows the guest a 1,271.20 euro total, and checkout re-validates Q1 and gets the same total.

visual_goal: Show the offer pipeline as a narrowing funnel: eligibility and party fit remove what cannot be booked, normalization makes conditions comparable, pruning removes dominated offers, and grouping produces a readable rooms table.
prompt: A top-to-bottom funnel made of seven stacked horizontal bands that get narrower toward the bottom, with one short downward arrow between each pair of neighbouring bands. From top to bottom the bands are labeled: 'Rate catalog', 'Eligible', 'Fits the party', 'Normalized', 'Pruned', 'Grouped', and at the narrow bottom 'Rooms table'. Small cards fall off the sides of the upper bands into a faint discard tray, showing offers being removed. Beside 'Normalized', small differently shaped cards become identical rounded cards. The bottom band opens onto a clean small table with three grouped rows and one row marked with a check.
alt: A funnel from rate catalog through eligible, fits the party, normalized, pruned and grouped down to a short rooms table, with offers falling away at each stage.
